name: scyne-stack
description: Local orchestration for the Scyne requirements generator stack. Runs the npm-published Paperclip (paperclipai) embedded — no external clone needed.

scripts.setup: npm install && cd scyne-chatbot && npm install
scripts.link-skills: mkdir -p .claude/skills && for s in skills/*/; do n=$(basename "$s"); rm -rf ".claude/skills/$n"; ln -s "../../skills/$n" ".claude/skills/$n"; done && ls -l .claude/skills
scripts.dev: concurrently -n paperclip,app -c blue,green "npm:paperclip" "npm run bootstrap && npm run chatbot"
